task: Write an execution plan for a threshold-triggered 3x2 review escalation gate.
outcome: User sees: Wrote docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md with the exact trigger rule, host-independence requirements, implementation touchpoints, tests, rollout, and acceptance criteria for the 3 round x 2 host gate.
facts: Normal story REVIEW currently starts as a standard Lattice reviewer flow and can pass after one round when no blockers remain.
Decision-doc changes under docs/requirements/decisions/*.md already have a local DONE quorum gate requiring 3 rounds with 2 PASSing hosts per round.
Audit found the current decision-doc quorum only counts hostId strings and does not prove independent host/session/key identity.
finding_add defaults evidenceState to verified; suspected and disproven findings are advisory and should not trigger escalation.
review_run_start binds REVIEW evidence to a signed current review round with head/material hash freshness.
B-1550 decision_set selected threshold-triggered escalation plus a stronger shared host-independence predicate.
constraints: Do not implement source-code changes in this story.
Write the execution plan in English for open-source readiness.
The plan must make 3x2 automatic for all development when first REVIEW round records two or more verified findings.
Decision-doc changes must remain always-on 3x2 regardless of findings count.
Gate-consumed facts must be mechanically enforced by CLI/handlers/gates and registered in process fact registry, not prompt-only.
